resources.string:
读取大麦(cn.damai)界面上已显示的文字，找出标有“已预约”的演出，并在悬浮窗里显示它的开票倒计时。为了能识别“已离开大麦”，会看到切换到了哪个应用，但只读取其名称，从不读取其界面内容。

另外会代替你点击购票按钮：该演出的开票时间到达时，会自动点击页面上的“立即预订”；长按悬浮窗也可立即点击购票按钮。不会输入文字，不会付款。

Reads the text already shown on Damai's (cn.damai) screen to find the show marked 已预约 (reserved) and count down to its on-sale time in a floating pill. To detect that you've left Damai, it sees which app you switch to, but only its name — it never reads that app's on-screen content.

It also taps for you: when that show's on-sale time arrives, it presses 立即预订 on the page. Long-pressing the pill presses the buy button immediately. It never types and never pays.
